writing.exampleCaption: The quorum is where the choice is actually made.
writing.explanation: When the network splits you either refuse writes to stay consistent, or accept them and diverge. Everything else — quorums, leader election, eventual consistency, CRDTs — is a way of choosing where on that line to sit. Saying pick two is the answer that gets followed up; saying what your system does during a partition is the one that lands.
writing.feedback: Carts are merge-friendly, so availability is worth more than strictness.
